actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: sense magic
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic} spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes 2 [[/item Pincer]] attacks and uses [[/item Paralyzing Tentacles]].

actions.name: paralyzing tentacles
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=p157Iqz8s0M0VilW]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=p157Iqz8s0M0VilW]] Grappled by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition.

actions.name: pincer
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of two pincers.
